# AC judge

Behaviour-driven development is a methodology in which teams describe the
behaviour of a system in a shared language. It grew out of test-driven
development and emphasises conversation between developers, testers and the
business. Given/when/then is one way practitioners write scenarios, and many
teams find it helps them agree on what done means.

Reject the change when any acceptance criterion has no test that proves it.
